description: This file defines API routes for managing categories within a FastAPI application. It includes route handlers for creating, listing, updating, and deleting categories, utilizing dependency injection for database sessions and user authentication. The code interacts with a service layer (CategoryService) for business logic and employs schema models for request and response validation.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define API endpoints.

methods.name: CategoryOut create_category( payload: CategoryCreate, user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), )
methods.description: Handler for creating a new category, validates input, handles exceptions, and returns the created category.

methods.name: list[CategoryOut] list_categories( q: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Search term"), limit: int = Query(default=20, ge=1, le=100), offset: int = Query(default=0, ge=0), user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), )
methods.description: Handler for retrieving a list of categories owned by the current user, supports search and pagination.

methods.name: CategoryOut update_category( category_id: int, payload: CategoryUpdate, user_id: int = Depends(get_current_user_id), db: Session = Depends(get_db_dep), )
methods.description: Handler for updating an existing category's name with permission and validation checks.

methods.description: Handler for deleting a category, returns 204 status code on success.
